Our journey so far

From single-site contracts in 2015 to a full engineering-led practice.
2015 — The Beginning
True Construction starts with small residential contracts around Thondi, built entirely on word of mouth and site discipline.
Going Professional
Civil engineering oversight brought fully in-house — every project now runs through proper structural planning.
Steady Growth
Monthly project intake becomes consistent, with commercial work and premium villas added alongside homes.
Today
75+ projects delivered — a trusted local name, engineering-led and site-supervised from foundation to handover.
01 — Foundation & layout marking
02 — Structure rising, floor by floor
03 — Finished & handed over
